sources.snippet: NaviDC-OCR is a lightweight (~1.2B parameters), open-source Vision-Language Model designed specifically for document understanding. Unlike existing approaches that primarily focus on either digital documents or camera-captured documents, NaviDC-OCR provides a unified framework for both scenarios.
